claim_label: Does user feedback inherently reduce AI model bias?
description: This conflict examines whether user interaction creates a self-correcting mechanism for AI bias or if it inadvertently amplifies existing stereotypes through engagement-driven optimization.

instances.assertion: Yes, user feedback signals failures, forcing developers to patch models to maintain market competitiveness.
No, without transparency, user feedback often reinforces biases by optimizing for engagement metrics that favor stereotypes.
